Vishal Kumar, Addl. P.P.
------
Order No.02 Dated- 10.11.2023 Heard the parties.
The petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of regular bail in connection with Bishnugarh P.S. Case No.90 of 2023 registered under sections 365/323/341/376/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner in furtherance of common intention committed rape upon the informant.
It is further submitted that the allegation against the petitioner are all false.

It is then submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner, drawing attention of this Court to annexure-2 at page no.22 of the brief that the informant has categorically stated that because of some misunderstanding and wrong typing of the typist, the victim has erroneously implicated the petitioner in this case for having committed rape upon her.
It is then submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 31.07.2023 as mentioned in paragraph no. 14 of the bail application.
It is next submitted that the petitioner undertakes to cooperate with the trial of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be admitted to bail.
The learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am inclined to enlarge the above named petitioner on bail.
